title: Mediterranean mooring step by step
lead: Stern-to mooring is how most Mediterranean harbours work. Here is how to prepare, approach and tie up with lazy lines or your own anchor, calmly and without drama.
description: How to moor stern-to in the Mediterranean with lazy lines or your own anchor: crew briefing, prop walk, the approach, crossed anchors and leaving.
summary: Prepare fenders on both sides, two stern lines, a boathook and a briefed crew before you enter.
Learn your boat's prop walk and approach slowly astern, aiming upwind of the gap in a crosswind.
Walk the lazy line forward to the bow, or drop your anchor 3 to 4 boat lengths out and lay chain in a line.
Keep lines out of the water near the propeller.
